question: Why are these powers called Kalikas and how is the supreme described in the Sara scripture?
premises: These powers are called Kalikas because of knowledge that measures limitation.
This naming is found in some sources.
The revered Sara scripture also speaks of a supreme one-syllabled power in the middle.
inference: The Kalikas are named from limiting cognition, while the Sara scripture points to a supreme single-syllabled power at the center.
uncertainties: The identity of the one syllable is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Because of knowledge that measures limitation, these powers are called Kalikas in some places; and in the revered Sara scripture, the supreme one-syllabled power is said to be in the middle.
